note: This is a rollout SPEC, not a training-ready buffer. Each row names a Docker image plus setup/verifier scripts inside the task-data tarball; consuming it requires a rollout manager that (1) starts one container per sampled rollout, (2) routes the agent's Bash calls into it, (3) runs tests/test.sh at episode end, (4) returns that verifier result as reward, (5) tears the container down. The repo's existing recipe/slime path is offline replay-GRPO over recorded TB2 rewards and does none of those things.
